description: Pro, owner only: save one provider key, sealed with AES-256-GCM before it reaches the database. Providers: vercel (Vercel Sandbox, default), e2b, daytona, modal, workers (Workers Sandbox). Vercel needs team_id and project_id; Modal and Workers Sandbox need bridge_url (see provider_setup). The key is checked with a read-only call first and is never returned or logged. Free stores nothing.

bridge_url.description: Modal / Workers Sandbox: https URL of the bridge you deployed.

name.description: Label for this key, default the provider name. Use it in run_job provider.

project_id.description: Vercel: project id or name the sandboxes bill to.

provider.description: vercel, e2b, daytona, modal or workers.

skip_check.description: Save without the read-only check (not recommended).

token.description: The provider API key or token (or your bridge token).

name: save_provider_key
